verse.verse_2: And what will make you to know what At-Tariq is
verse.verse_4: There is no human being but has a protector over him.
verse.verse_5: So, let man see from what he is created!
verse.verse_6: He is created from a water gushing forth,
verse.verse_7: Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs.
verse.verse_8: Verily, He is Able to bring him back!
verse.verse_9: The Day when all the secrets will be examined.
verse.verse_10: Then he will have no power, nor any helper.
verse.verse_11: By the sky which gives rain, again and again.
verse.verse_13: Verily, this is the Word that separates.
verse.verse_14: And it is not a thing for amusement.
verse.verse_15: Verily, they are but plotting a plot.
verse.verse_16: And I am planning a plan.
verse.verse_17: So, give a respite to the disbelievers; deal gently with them for a while.
